name: Verbal Abuse
overview: Scripture reveals the profound impact of words, describing how the tongue can either wound like a sword or bring healing and life. The wise use their speech to promote peace, as a gentle answer can defuse anger, whereas harsh words provoke strife. Believers are cautioned against associating with angry and furious individuals, whose words and actions lead to transgression and conflict. In times of verbal abuse, the Lord is near to the brokenhearted, offering comfort and salvation to those with a contrite spirit.
